inputs.original_text: A Wisconsin jury found Harry Wait guilty of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge for requesting ballots in the names of Republican Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason without their consent. After a two-day trial, the Racine County jury acquitted him of a second identity theft count. Wait leads a group that makes false election claims, and he admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to show that Wisconsin’s voter registration system was vulnerable to fraud.
